name: Fitness review gates (scripts/fitness-gates.py)
purpose: Evaluates the four review gates from the project files and the checks; automated evidence can fail a gate but accuracy gates need a named human in qa/fitness-signoff.json.

compatibility.runtime: python3.12 or node; ffmpeg where noted
compatibility.notes: Heavy browser steps take the host render lock.

security.notes: Writes qa/gates.json; never writes the sign-off file.

licensing.notes: Internal workspace component; no third-party code copied.
